item.title: The day after Goodbye
item.description: THE DAY AFTER GOODBYE. A sunny New Year's day greets Victoria Plaza, a day after it closed its doors on December 31, 2025. As the first mall in Davao City, Victoria would have turned 33 this March. Netizens continue to share nostalgic memories while looking forward to a better redevelopment by Robinsons Land, the new owner that acquired it from homegrown NCCC Davao. MindaNews photo by DANILO BALUCOS
